newer_changes_search: Cabinet continued PM-KISAN from 2026-27 to 2030-31 (PIB 31 Jul 2026, cited); ₹6,000 in three instalments unchanged. No change to exclusions found.

findings.note: Guidelines para 5.1 exempt North-East States and Jharkhand from the land-records condition. A hard confirmed fail on owns_farmland ('in its own name') can rule out eligible farmers there.
findings.suggestion: Mention the NE/Jharkhand exception in how_to_apply, or treat the rule as 'uncertain' for those states.

findings.note: The 01.02.2019 land-ownership cut-off (paras 5.2-5.3; later acquisitions count only if inherited) is not mentioned. The guideline set it 'for next 5 years'; whether it still applies needs a newer source.
findings.suggestion: Add one sentence if a current source confirms it still applies.
